data: Is the value of the orange line higher than the value of the blue line for augmentation size 1 in the 'Restaurant' plot?

The orange line represents BERT-FTC, and the blue line represents DE-CNN. For augmentation size 1 in the 'Restaurant' plot, the orange line is below the blue line. Therefore, the value of the orange line is not higher than the value of the blue line for augmentation size 1 in the 'Restaurant' plot.
